caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object in a three-quarter view, positioned at an angle on a light, neutral background. The object has a warm brown coloration throughout, with subtle variations in shading to indicate depth and dimension. It appears to be a piece of furniture, resembling a bench or chest with a lid that curves and is contoured at the top, possibly functioning as a seat or storage compartment. The object has two curved legs or supports on its base, extending outward on each side, and a handle-like feature in the middle of the lid’s surface, as well as on the side of the object. The surfaces of the object are outlined with dark lines, and the overall shape is asymmetrical with one end higher and more decorative, while the other end is lower and flatter. The background is otherwise plain, with a faint rectangular boundary around the object, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Hooded Cradle
